_comment: Hand-written. Where each interactive figure goes: 'label' is a LaTeX \label of a figure or of a (sub)section in the notes; the interactive is placed right after that figure or heading. 'module' is the file notes/diffgeo-gr/assets/interactive/<module>.js. Regenerating the pages never touches this file or the modules. 'notebook' (optional) is the path of the notebook in the package repository (github.com/daniellopezcano/differential_geometry, branch main) that the panel's footer links to (D55).
